key: How do you feel about captivity?\ch[62,-1, FML., New friend!!!, I just hope he's good., I think I'll miss the wild..., Just let me out of the stupid Pokéball, Company might not be so bad, It's an opportunity to get stronger!, Running away ASAP, Costs and benefits remain to be seen.]

ja: 捕まったことについてどう思う?\ch[62,-1, 最悪だ, 新しい友達!!!, いい人だといいけど, 野生が恋しくなりそう……, さっさとこのバカなモンスターボールから出して, 一緒にいるのも悪くないかも, 強くなるチャンスだ!, さっさと逃げる, 損得はまだ分からない]

key: Your new Trainer, Elliot, decides he wants you to get stronger.
en: Your new Trainer, Elliot, decides he wants you to get stronger.
ja: あなたの新しいトレーナー、エリオットは、あなたを強くしたいと考えている。

key: He goes out and challenges the first Trainer he sees, and next thing you know you're facing off against a very strong-looking Greninja!
en: He goes out and challenges the first Trainer he sees, and next thing you know you're facing off against a very strong-looking Greninja!
ja: 彼は外に出て、最初に見かけたトレーナーに挑み、気づけばあなたは、いかにも強そうなゲッコウガと対決していた!

key: In fact, it seems to be around 20-30 levels above you!
en: In fact, it seems to be around 20-30 levels above you!
ja: 実際、レベルが20~30も上のようだ!

key: What will you do?\ch[62,-1, ...I'll do my best!, Can I just forfeit?, Quit. Bye., Level doesn't matter! Let's fight!!!, I must learn to overcome this difference, I choose to have faith in my Trainer, Ask how many Potions Elliot has..., Perhaps we're being switch-trained?, Elliot's an idiot.]
en: What will you do?\ch[62,-1, ...I'll do my best!, Can I just forfeit?, Quit. Bye., Level doesn't matter! Let's fight!!!, I must learn to overcome this difference, I choose to have faith in my Trainer, Ask how many Potions Elliot has..., Perhaps we're being switch-trained?, Elliot's an idiot.]
ja: どうする?\ch[62,-1, ……全力を尽くす!, 棄権していい?, やめる。バイバイ, レベルなんて関係ない! 戦うぞ!!!, この差を乗り越える術を学ばなければ, トレーナーを信じることにする, エリオットが何個キズぐすりを持ってるか聞く……, もしかして、これって特訓されてる?, エリオットはバカだ]

key: Unfortunately, and perhaps predictably, your battle with Greninja goes poorly.
en: Unfortunately, and perhaps predictably, your battle with Greninja goes poorly.
ja: 残念ながら、というか予想通り、ゲッコウガとのバトルはうまくいかなかった。

key: Elliot thinks you need to fight some weaker Pokémon to get stronger instead.
en: Elliot thinks you need to fight some weaker Pokémon to get stronger instead.
ja: エリオットは、代わりにもっと弱いポケモンと戦って強くなるべきだと考えた。

key: The next thing you know, you're up against a baby Skitty.
en: The next thing you know, you're up against a baby Skitty.
ja: 気づけば、あなたは赤ちゃんのエネコと対決していた。

key: It seems to just be fresh out of the egg, let alone hardly a match.
en: It seems to just be fresh out of the egg, let alone hardly a match.
ja: タマゴからかえったばかりのようで、勝負にすらならなそうだ。

key: Elliot commands you to go all-out.
en: Elliot commands you to go all-out.
ja: エリオットは、全力で戦えと命じた。

key: What do you do?\ch[62,-1, KO it. Sucks to suck., I refuse to attack!, Attack but as gently as possible, KO it and suffer the guilt, Befriend the Skitty and play instead, Attack Elliot for being dumb, Teach the Skitty to play dead instead, Pretend to attack but miss on purpose, I will do as I am told.]
en: What do you do?\ch[62,-1, KO it. Sucks to suck., I refuse to attack!, Attack but as gently as possible, KO it and suffer the guilt, Befriend the Skitty and play instead, Attack Elliot for being dumb, Teach the Skitty to play dead instead, Pretend to attack but miss on purpose, I will do as I am told.]
ja: どうする?\ch[62,-1, ノックアウトする。弱いのが悪い, 攻撃を拒否する!, できるだけ優しく攻撃する, ノックアウトして罪悪感に苦しむ, エネコと仲良くなって遊ぶことにする, バカなことをしたエリオットを攻撃する, 代わりにエネコに死んだふりを教える, 攻撃するふりをして、わざと外す, 言われた通りにする]

key: Elliot finally gets a sense of your power level, and begins to match you against more appropriate opponents.
en: Elliot finally gets a sense of your power level, and begins to match you against more appropriate opponents.
ja: エリオットはようやくあなたの実力を把握し、もっと見合った相手と戦わせるようになった。

key: In a heated battle with a Persian, you score a strong hit, nearly KOing your opponent.
en: In a heated battle with a Persian, you score a strong hit, nearly KOing your opponent.
ja: ペルシアンとの白熱したバトルで、あなたは強烈な一撃を決め、相手をあと少しでノックアウトするところまで追い詰めた。

key: But suddenly, Persian's Slash scores a critical hit, robbing you of an otherwise clean win!
en: But suddenly, Persian's Slash scores a critical hit, robbing you of an otherwise clean win!
ja: しかし突然、ペルシアンの「きりさく」が急所に当たり、確実だったはずの勝利を奪われてしまった!

key: How do you feel after the loss?\ch[62,-1, Mad at myself. I let it happen., Pissed at Persian, Indifferent. It happens., I'd feel sorry at first and then get over it, The next Persian I see will feel it., I'll just have to do better next time., Elliot should have accounted for that., I should've been ready for the crit., I feel like getting ice cream!]
en: How do you feel after the loss?\ch[62,-1, Mad at myself. I let it happen., Pissed at Persian, Indifferent. It happens., I'd feel sorry at first and then get over it, The next Persian I see will feel it., I'll just have to do better next time., Elliot should have accounted for that., I should've been ready for the crit., I feel like getting ice cream!]
ja: 負けた後、どう感じる?\ch[62,-1, 自分に腹が立つ。自分が許してしまった, ペルシアンにムカつく, 無関心。よくあることだ, 最初は落ち込むけど、すぐ立ち直る, 次に会うペルシアンに思い知らせてやる, 次はもっとうまくやるしかない, エリオットがそれを考慮しておくべきだった, 急所に備えておくべきだった, アイスクリームが食べたい気分!]

key: Elliot just picked up a brand new TM he wants to teach you to help you get stronger!
en: Elliot just picked up a brand new TM he wants to teach you to help you get stronger!
ja: エリオットは、あなたを強くするために教えたい、真新しいわざマシンを手に入れた!

key: It's the TM for Explosion.
en: It's the TM for Explosion.
ja: それは「だいばくはつ」のわざマシンだ。

key: How do you feel about that?\ch[62,-1, The Trainer knows best., You're kidding right?, Was this TM ethically reviewed?, Power attacks are nice but..., Clearly Elliot doesn't care, Elliot is denser than lead., I refuse to learn the move!!!, I'm hoping someone will save me..., BOOOOOOM!!!!!]
en: How do you feel about that?\ch[62,-1, The Trainer knows best., You're kidding right?, Was this TM ethically reviewed?, Power attacks are nice but..., Clearly Elliot doesn't care, Elliot is denser than lead., I refuse to learn the move!!!, I'm hoping someone will save me..., BOOOOOOM!!!!!]
ja: それについてどう思う?\ch[62,-1, トレーナーが一番分かってる, 冗談だよね?, このわざマシン、倫理審査は通ってるの?, 強力な技はいいけど……, 明らかにエリオットは気にしてない, エリオットは鉛より鈍感だ, その技を覚えるのは拒否する!!!, 誰かに助けてもらいたい……, ドカーーーン!!!!!]

key: Elliot just caught a low-level Gothita!
en: Elliot just caught a low-level Gothita!
ja: エリオットは、低レベルのゴチムを捕まえたばかりだ!

key: He tries her out in a few battles, but she's not doing too well.
en: He tries her out in a few battles, but she's not doing too well.
ja: 何度かバトルで試してみるが、あまりうまくいかない。

key: In fact, she can hardly get in one or two hits before being KO'd.
en: In fact, she can hardly get in one or two hits before being KO'd.
ja: 実際、一発か二発当てる前にノックアウトされてしまう。

key: At a rare break, Gothita asks if she's doing something wrong.
en: At a rare break, Gothita asks if she's doing something wrong.
ja: 珍しい休憩時間に、ゴチムは自分が何か間違っているのか尋ねてきた。

key: What do you tell Gothita?\ch[62,-1, She just needs to evolve, Elliot's just an idiot., She's perfect as is!, Use her emotions as strength, Maybe we can train together!, She needs to work harder, She needs to stop complaining, Everyone starts somewhere., Whatever happens happens.]
en: What do you tell Gothita?\ch[62,-1, She just needs to evolve, Elliot's just an idiot., She's perfect as is!, Use her emotions as strength, Maybe we can train together!, She needs to work harder, She needs to stop complaining, Everyone starts somewhere., Whatever happens happens.]
ja: ゴチムに何と言う?\ch[62,-1, 進化すればいいだけ, エリオットがただのバカなだけ, 今のままで完璧だよ!, 感情を強さに変えなさい, 一緒に鍛えられるかも!, もっと頑張る必要がある, 文句を言うのはやめるべき, みんなどこかから始まるものだ, なるようになるさ]

key: An Ace Trainer named Brian appears and challenges Elliot to a Double Battle!
en: An Ace Trainer named Brian appears and challenges Elliot to a Double Battle!
ja: エリートトレーナーのブライアンが現れ、エリオットにダブルバトルを挑んできた!

key: It's Elliot's first one, and yours too.
en: It's Elliot's first one, and yours too.
ja: エリオットにとっても、あなたにとっても初めてのダブルバトルだ。

key: He opens up by sending you out alongside Gothita!
en: He opens up by sending you out alongside Gothita!
ja: エリオットは開幕、あなたとゴチムを一緒に繰り出した!

key: You know Gothita won't survive more than a single attack.
en: You know Gothita won't survive more than a single attack.
ja: ゴチムが一発の攻撃にも耐えられないことを、あなたは知っている。

key: What do you do?\ch[62,-1, Put her on back and carry, Keep a positive attitude, Protect Gothita at my own risk!, Whatever I'm told to do., Just KO the enemy first-- duh., Whatever happens will be fine, Stop the fight, Analyze how best to use her, Where's that Explosion TM?]
en: What do you do?\ch[62,-1, Put her on back and carry, Keep a positive attitude, Protect Gothita at my own risk!, Whatever I'm told to do., Just KO the enemy first-- duh., Whatever happens will be fine, Stop the fight, Analyze how best to use her, Where's that Explosion TM?]
ja: どうする?\ch[62,-1, 背負って運ぶ, 前向きな姿勢を保つ, 自分の危険を顧みずゴチムを守る!, 言われた通りにする, とにかく先に敵をノックアウトする――当然だろ, なるようになる, 戦いを止める, どう活かすのが一番いいか分析する, さっきの「だいばくはつ」のわざマシンはどこ?]

key: Fortunately, Elliot realizes Gothita's in trouble and switches her out.
en: Fortunately, Elliot realizes Gothita's in trouble and switches her out.
ja: 幸い、エリオットはゴチムがピンチだと気づき、交代させた。

key: Instead he sends in his very first Pokémon: a high level Luxray!
en: Instead he sends in his very first Pokémon: a high level Luxray!
ja: 代わりに、彼の最初のポケモンである、高レベルのレントラーを繰り出した!

key: It's obvious it outpowers you.
en: It's obvious it outpowers you.
ja: レントラーがあなたより格上なのは明らかだ。

key: How do you save face?\ch[62,-1, Accept failure with pride, Treat it as a test for myself, Just accept the easy win, Save face? en: How do you save face?\ch[62,-1, Accept failure with pride, Treat it as a test for myself, Just accept the easy win, Save face? This is Elliot's fault, Put the enemy into the dirt first, Consider it a sacrifice for Gothita, Just laugh it off!, Focus on strategy over power, It's a learning opportunity]
ja: どうやって面目を保つ?\ch[62,-1, 誇りを持って敗北を受け入れる, 自分自身への試練だと捉える, 楽な勝ちをそのまま受け入れる, 面目? これはエリオットのせいだ, 先に敵をとことんたたきのめす, ゴチムのための犠牲だと考える, 笑って済ませる!, 力より戦略に集中する, 学びの機会だ]

key: The battle rages on!
en: The battle rages on!
ja: 戦いは激しさを増していく!

key: You and Luxray face off against Brian's Starmie and Skarmory!
en: You and Luxray face off against Brian's Starmie and Skarmory!
ja: あなたとレントラーは、ブライアンのヒトデマンとエアームドと対決する!

key: Elliot notices they're both weak to Electric attacks, so he commands Luxray to hit them both at once with Discharge!
en: Elliot notices they're both weak to Electric attacks, so he commands Luxray to hit them both at once with Discharge!
ja: エリオットは、両方がでんきタイプの技に弱いことに気づき、レントラーに「ほうでん」で両方まとめて攻撃するよう命じた!

key: Luxray glances at you, but charges up for the hit. Elliot hasn't even considered that you would be attacked also!
en: Luxray glances at you, but charges up for the hit.  Elliot hasn't even considered that you would be attacked also!
ja: レントラーはあなたをちらりと見るが、そのまま攻撃をため始めた。エリオットは、あなたも攻撃を受けることなど考えてもいないのだ!

key: How do you feel?\ch[62,-1, Please think of me!!!, Do as you must., I'll get Luxray back later., I feel that my Trainer is dumb., I realize I don't matter., Bracing for impact!, I take the hit but Luxray owes me., Gettin' mad at Luxray and Elliot both, Running. I feel like running.]
en: How do you feel?\ch[62,-1, Please think of me!!!, Do as you must., I'll get Luxray back later., I feel that my Trainer is dumb., I realize I don't matter., Bracing for impact!, I take the hit but Luxray owes me., Gettin' mad at Luxray and Elliot both, Running. I feel like running.]
ja: どう感じる?\ch[62,-1, お願い、わたしのことも考えて!!!, やるべきことをやって, 後でレントラーに仕返しする, トレーナーってバカだなと思う, 自分なんてどうでもいい存在なんだと気づく, 衝撃に備える!, 攻撃は受けるけど、レントラーに貸し一つ, レントラーにもエリオットにも腹が立つ, 逃げる。逃げたい気分だ]

key: Starmie, Skarmory, and yourself all manage to survive the Discharge.
en: Starmie, Skarmory, and yourself all manage to survive the Discharge.
ja: ヒトデマン、エアームド、そしてあなた自身も、なんとか「ほうでん」を耐えきった。

key: Both of them attack Luxray, and now all four Pokémon are really weak!
en: Both of them attack Luxray, and now all four Pokémon are really weak!
ja: 二匹ともレントラーを攻撃し、今や4匹全員がかなり弱っている!

key: Elliot, thinking that Discharge worked well, commands you to use an attack that would hit everyone on the field, KOing Skarmory, Starmie, and Luxray all at once!
en: Elliot, thinking that Discharge worked well, commands you to use an attack that would hit everyone on the field, KOing Skarmory, Starmie, and Luxray all at once!
ja: エリオットは、「ほうでん」がうまくいったと思い、あなたに場にいる全員に当たる技を使うよう命じた。エアームド、ヒトデマン、レントラーを一気にノックアウトすることになる!

key: Will you take the kills?\ch[62,-1, A win is a win., I will do it if I'm told to., I won't take my partner down!, I'll attack but I won't like it, Luxray will still have contributed to the win, I'll sincerely apologize to Luxray first, What happens to Luxray isn't my problem, Done deal. en: Will you take the kills?\ch[62,-1, A win is a win., I will do it if I'm told to., I won't take my partner down!, I'll attack but I won't like it, Luxray will still have contributed to the win, I'll sincerely apologize to Luxray first, What happens to Luxray isn't my problem, Done deal. It's revenge for the Discharge., Can't we find an enemy-only move instead?]
ja: それでも仕留める?\ch[62,-1, 勝ちは勝ちだ, 言われたらやる, 相棒を倒したりしない!, 攻撃はするけど、気は進まない, レントラーだって勝利に貢献したことになる, まずレントラーに心から謝る, レントラーがどうなろうと自分には関係ない, 決まりだ。「ほうでん」の仕返しだ, 敵だけに当たる技を探せないの?]

key: Luxray, Starmie, and Skarmory are all knocked out and Elliot wins the battle!
en: Luxray, Starmie, and Skarmory are all knocked out and Elliot wins the battle!
ja: レントラー、ヒトデマン、エアームドは全員ノックアウトされ、エリオットが勝利した!

key: But now Elliot is mad at you for hurting his prized Luxray!
en: But now Elliot is mad at you for hurting his prized Luxray!
ja: しかし今、エリオットは大切なレントラーを傷つけたことで、あなたに腹を立てている!

key: He's even talking about releasing you because of it!
en: He's even talking about releasing you because of it!
ja: それが原因で、あなたを逃がすことまで口にし始めている!

key: How do you react?\ch[62,-1, Isn't that unfair?!, If it's really what you want..., I'm so sorry! I'll try better!, You TOLD me to do it., Pissed. Go ahead and release me!, You'd be better off without me anyway., Perhaps parting is for the best., Just take Luxray to a Pokémon Center..., Sweet mercy-- let me OUT.]
en: How do you react?\ch[62,-1, Isn't that unfair?!, If it's really what you want..., I'm so sorry! I'll try better!, You TOLD me to do it., Pissed. Go ahead and release me!, You'd be better off without me anyway., Perhaps parting is for the best., Just take Luxray to a Pokémon Center..., Sweet mercy-- let me OUT.]
ja: どう反応する?\ch[62,-1, それって不公平じゃない!?, 本当にそう望むなら……, 本当にごめんなさい! もっと頑張るから!, あんたが命令したんじゃないか, ムカつく。もう逃がせばいいでしょ!, どうせ自分がいないほうがマシなんでしょ, 別れるのが一番なのかもしれない, とにかくレントラーをポケモンセンターに連れて行って……, 頼むから――出して]

key: On that note, how do you feel about Elliot overall? \ch[62,-1, He has a lot to learn., He's not a bad person but..., He's too immature to function., Kill me now., Maybe I can help him be better!, Elliot is an idiot., I'd rather not be alone still., I hope he trips off the edge of a cliff., He's simply not worth the time.]
en: On that note, how do you feel about Elliot overall? \ch[62,-1, He has a lot to learn., He's not a bad person but..., He's too immature to function., Kill me now., Maybe I can help him be better!, Elliot is an idiot., I'd rather not be alone still., I hope he trips off the edge of a cliff., He's simply not worth the time.]
ja: ところで、エリオットについて全体的にどう思う? \ch[62,-1, まだまだ学ぶことが多い人, 悪い人じゃないけど……, 未熟すぎてまともに機能してない, もう殺してくれ, もっと良くなる手助けができるかも!, エリオットはバカだ, それでも一人はやだ, 崖から足を踏み外せばいいのに, ただ時間の無駄な相手だ]

key: Elliot leaves you and Gothita out of your Pokéballs and runs away to take Luxray to the Pokémon Center.
en: Elliot leaves you and Gothita out of your Pokéballs and runs away to take Luxray to the Pokémon Center.
ja: エリオットは、あなたとゴチムをモンスターボールから出したまま、レントラーをポケモンセンターに連れて走り去った。

key: He said he needs time to think.
en: He said he needs time to think.
ja: 考える時間が必要だと言っていた。

key: After being mad at you, and disappointed in Gothita's poor performance, it seems like he might abandon the both of you.
en: After being mad at you, and disappointed in Gothita's poor performance, it seems like he might abandon the both of you.
ja: あなたに腹を立て、ゴチムの不かいなさにも失望した様子で、二人とも見捨ててしまうかもしれない。

key: As Elliot leaves, Gothita begins to cry.
en: As Elliot leaves, Gothita begins to cry.
ja: エリオットが去っていくと、ゴチムは泣き始めた。

key: What do you do?\ch[62,-1, I'm not getting involved here, Reassure her she didn't mess up, Offer to listen to her, Nothing-- it's not my problem, Let's run away with Gothita!, Offer Gothita some choice advice, Talk smack about Elliot to cheer her up!, Encourage her to have faith in herself, I'll cheer for her from a distance]
en: What do you do?\ch[62,-1, I'm not getting involved here, Reassure her she didn't mess up, Offer to listen to her, Nothing-- it's not my problem, Let's run away with Gothita!, Offer Gothita some choice advice, Talk smack about Elliot to cheer her up!, Encourage her to have faith in herself, I'll cheer for her from a distance]
ja: どうする?\ch[62,-1, ここには関わらない, 失敗じゃないと安心させる, 話を聞くと申し出る, 何もしない――自分には関係ない, ゴチムと一緒に逃げよう!, ゴチムに的確なアドバイスをする, エリオットの悪口を言って元気づける!, 自分を信じるよう励ます, 遠くから応援する]

key: Before Elliot comes back, you're found instead by Brian, the Ace Trainer from before!
en: Before Elliot comes back, you're found instead by Brian, the Ace Trainer from before!
ja: エリオットが戻ってくる前に、代わりに先ほどのエリートトレーナー、ブライアンに見つかった!

key: He recognizes you and takes you to find Elliot.
en: He recognizes you and takes you to find Elliot.
ja: 彼はあなたに気づき、エリオットを探しに連れていく。

key: Elliot has calmed down, and begins talking with Brian.
en: Elliot has calmed down, and begins talking with Brian.
ja: エリオットは落ち着きを取り戻し、ブライアンと話し始める。

key: After a little while, Brian says that he was very impressed with your performance in the battle and offers to trade his Starmie for you!
en: After a little while, Brian says that he was very impressed with your performance in the battle and offers to trade his Starmie for you!
ja: しばらくして、ブライアンはバトルでのあなたの活躍にとても感心したと言い、自分のヒトデマンとの交換を持ちかけてきた!

key: Elliot thinks it over, and after a while, he accepts!
en: Elliot thinks it over, and after a while, he accepts!
ja: エリオットはしばらく考え、やがて承諾する!

key: How do you feel about the trade?\ch[62,-1, Did I do something wrong?, Better Brian than Elliot., Good for me but bad for Starmie, Excited! But nervous..., Who will look out for Gothita?, New friends! But I hate saying goodbye, If he lost to Elliot is he even better?, Change means good things can happen!, Can't I just be released instead?]
en: How do you feel about the trade?\ch[62,-1, Did I do something wrong?, Better Brian than Elliot., Good for me but bad for Starmie, Excited! en: Their impulsiveness can often lead to things getting out of hand, but their positive nature lends itself to smoothing over conflicts and making a lot of fun memories along the way.
ja: 衝動的な性格のせいで物事が手に負えなくなることも多いが、その前向きな性質は争いを丸く収め、道中でたくさんの楽しい思い出を作るのに役立つ。

key: Grass Types tend to put others before themselves.
en: Grass Types tend to put others before themselves.
ja: くさタイプは、自分より他人を優先しがちだ。

key: They go out of their way to help and soothe others, and are great contributors to making the world a more positive, peaceful place.
en: They go out of their way to help and soothe others, and are great contributors to making the world a more positive, peaceful place.
ja: わざわざ他人を助け、慰め、世界をより前向きで平和な場所にすることに大きく貢献する。

key: Despite the fact that their habitual benevolence wins plenty of friends, they can also sometimes be insecure and prone to having doubts.
en: Despite the fact that their habitual benevolence wins plenty of friends, they can also sometimes be insecure and prone to having doubts.
ja: その習慣的な善意によって多くの友達を得る一方で、時に不安になり、疑いを抱きやすいこともある。

key: In reality though, Grass Types are often much more cherished than they will ever realize.
en: In reality though, Grass Types are often much more cherished than they will ever realize.
ja: しかし実際には、くさタイプは自分が思っている以上に、大切にされていることが多い。

key: Ice Types are some of the most charming and unique people,
en: Ice Types are some of the most charming and unique people,
ja: こおりタイプは、最も魅力的で個性的な人たちの一部だが、

key: But seldom do they realize it.
en: But seldom do they realize it.
ja: それに気づくことはめったにない。

key: Many Ice Types hide behind a veil of aloofness, often hiding how much they truly worry or care about others.
en: Many Ice Types hide behind a veil of aloofness, often hiding how much they truly worry or care about others.
ja: 多くのこおりタイプは、よそよそしさのベールの陰に隠れ、他人をどれほど心配し、大切に思っているかを、しばしば隠してしまう。

key: Their cool distance serves both to entice others, suggesting an air of mystery and refinement,
en: Their cool distance serves both to entice others, suggesting an air of mystery and refinement,
ja: その冷ややかな距離感は、神秘的で洗練された雰囲気を漂わせ、他人をひきつける一方で、

key: But at the same time, in hiding how much they truly care, they risk pushing others away and missing out on welcome opportunities.
en: But at the same time, in hiding how much they truly care, they risk pushing others away and missing out on welcome opportunities.
ja: 同時に、本当はどれだけ気にかけているかを隠すことで、他人を遠ざけ、望ましい機会を逃してしまう危険もある。

key: Fighting Types are models of determination.
en: Fighting Types are models of determination.
ja: かくとうタイプは、決意の手本だ。

key: Understanding that it is not the 100th strike that cracks the stone, but the 99 that came before it, no one is better able to set their mind to a task and stick to it.
en: Understanding that it is not the 100th strike that cracks the stone, but the 99 that came before it, no one is better able to set their mind to a task and stick to it.
ja: 石を割るのは100回目の一撃ではなく、それより前の99回だと理解しており、目標に心を定めてやり抜くことにかけては誰にも劣らない。

key: Working with a tireless fervor that many others can only dream of, Fighting Types are sure to achieve whatever they pursue with enough time and patience.
en: Working with a tireless fervor that many others can only dream of, Fighting Types are sure to achieve whatever they pursue with enough time and patience.
ja: 多くの人が夢見るしかないほどの、疲れ知らずの情熱で取り組み、かくとうタイプは、十分な時間と忍耐さえあれば、追い求めるものを必ず成し遂げる。

key: Poison Types are prone to resigning themselves to circumstances they don't truly wish to be in.
en: Poison Types are prone to resigning themselves to circumstances they don't truly wish to be in.
ja: どくタイプは、本当は望んでいない状況を、あきらめて受け入れてしまいがちだ。

key: They value others above themselves, and may give up on themselves too easily.
en: They value others above themselves, and may give up on themselves too easily.
ja: 自分より他人を大切にし、自分自身をあまりにも簡単にあきらめてしまうこともある。

key: In spite of these things, they often don't realize that they make for some of the best and closest friends that can be found.
en: In spite of these things, they often don't realize that they make for some of the best and closest friends that can be found.
ja: それでも、自分が見つけられる中で最も素晴らしく、最も親しい友人になれるということに、彼ら自身気づいていないことが多い。

key: Without ever realizing their own importance, they serve vital roles in the lives of those around them, all the while slowly building themselves up.
en: Without ever realizing their own importance, they serve vital roles in the lives of those around them, all the while slowly building themselves up.
ja: 自分の重要性に気づかないまま、周りの人々の人生で重要な役割を果たし、その一方でゆっくりと自分自身を築き上げていく。

key: Ground Types are pragmatic and stubborn.
en: Ground Types are pragmatic and stubborn.
ja: じめんタイプは、実利的で頑固だ。

key: Unphased by traditional notions of what's "right" or "best", Ground Types view life and society from the outside looking in.
en: Unphased by traditional notions of what's "right" or "best", Ground Types view life and society from the outside looking in.
ja: 「正しい」とか「最善」といった従来の考え方に動じることなく、じめんタイプは人生や社会を外側から見つめる。

key: They prefer to remain with their ideals regardless of the consequences, which tends to work out well given how firmly rooted in results and effectiveness they often are.
en: They prefer to remain with their ideals regardless of the consequences, which tends to work out well given how firmly rooted in results and effectiveness they often are.
ja: 結果がどうであれ自分の理想を貫くことを好むが、結果や効果にしっかり根ざしていることが多いため、それがうまくいく傾向にある。

key: Flying Types are free-spirited dreamers!
en: Flying Types are free-spirited dreamers!
ja: ひこうタイプは、自由な魂を持つ夢想家だ!

key: Always looking for bigger, better, more exciting things, they aren't necessarily bound to what they """should""" be doing.
en: Always looking for bigger, better, more exciting things, they aren't necessarily bound to what they """should""" be doing.
ja: 常により大きく、より良く、よりワクワクするものを求め、「やるべき」ことに必ずしも縛られない。

key: Sometimes this gets them in trouble, but some might say Flying Types have an uncanny ability to just narrowly avoid whatever dire consequences would come of their mischief.
en: Sometimes this gets them in trouble, but some might say Flying Types have an uncanny ability to just narrowly avoid whatever dire consequences would come of their mischief.
ja: それが時にトラブルの原因になることもあるが、ひこうタイプにはいたずらの深刻な結果を、間一髪で回避する不思議な能力があると言う人もいる。

key: Moreover, they have a ton of fun doing whatever it is they do, and always get the last laugh.
en: Moreover, they have a ton of fun doing whatever it is they do, and always get the last laugh.
ja: しかも、何をしていても大いに楽しみ、最後に笑うのはいつも彼らだ。

key: Psychic Types are intelligent and analytical.
en: Psychic Types are intelligent and analytical.
ja: エスパータイプは、知的で分析的だ。

key: They value creativity, thoughtfulness and understanding.
en: They value creativity, thoughtfulness and understanding.
ja: 創造性、思慮深さ、理解を大切にする。

key: They often see the pattern and reasons behind events and circumstances rather than the circumstances themselves, and thus thrive individually and socially.
en: They often see the pattern and reasons behind events and circumstances rather than the circumstances themselves, and thus thrive individually and socially.
ja: 出来事や状況そのものよりも、その背後にあるパターンや理由をよく見抜くため、個人としても社会的にも力を発揮する。

key: While they can sometimes miss the forest for the trees and be extraordinarily unique in their own rites, they seem to seldom mind this.
en: While they can sometimes miss the forest for the trees and be extraordinarily unique in their own rites, they seem to seldom mind this.
ja: 時に木を見て森を見ず、独自のやり方で並外れて個性的になることもあるが、それを気にすることはめったにないようだ。

key: Bug Types are intellectual and reclusive.
en: Bug Types are intellectual and reclusive.
ja: むしタイプは、知的で世捨て人気質だ。

key: They tend to be introverted, preferring books, games, or the internet to the company of real people.
en: They tend to be introverted, preferring books, games, or the internet to the company of real people.
ja: 内向的な傾向があり、実際の人付き合いより、本やゲーム、インターネットを好む。

key: The result is a surprisngly unique and refined perspective on many subjects, even if they are often unsure of how best to share it.
en: The result is a surprisngly unique and refined perspective on many subjects, even if they are often unsure of how best to share it.
ja: その結果、多くの物事について驚くほど独自で洗練された視点を持つが、どう伝えればいいか自信が持てないことも多い。

key: The best among Bug Types hollow out their own place in the world with like-minded individuals who share their passions and interests in the comforts of mutual respect and curiosity.
en: The best among Bug Types hollow out their own place in the world with like-minded individuals who share their passions and interests in the comforts of mutual respect and curiosity.
ja: 最も優れたむしタイプは、互いへの敬意と好奇心という心地よさの中で、情熱や興味を共有する同じ志を持つ人たちと、この世界に自分の居場所を築いていく。

key: Rock Types are unshakably loyal companions.
en: Rock Types are unshakably loyal companions.
ja: いわタイプは、揺るぎなく忠実な仲間だ。

key: Great at listening and following directions, those who earn the respect and service of a Rock Type are especially lucky.
en: Great at listening and following directions, those who earn the respect and service of a Rock Type are especially lucky.
ja: 話を聞き、指示に従うのが得意で、いわタイプの尊敬と献身を勝ち取った者は、特に幸運だと言える。

key: Rock Types always stick up for their friends, faithfully serve their communities, and dutifully manage their families.
en: Rock Types always stick up for their friends, faithfully serve their communities, and dutifully manage their families.
ja: いわタイプは常に友を守り、忠実にコミュニティに尽くし、律儀に家族の面倒を見る。

key: Despite this, they sometimes prefer to be left to their own devices, or might struggle to tear themselves away from negative people,
en: Despite this, they sometimes prefer to be left to their own devices, or might struggle to tear themselves away from negative people,
ja: それでも、時には放っておいてほしいと思ったり、否定的な人たちから離れるのに苦労したりすることもある。

key: But the burden of loyalty, while not an easy one to bear, is an invaluable and often overlooked cornerstone of society and our friendships.
en: But the burden of loyalty, while not an easy one to bear, is an invaluable and often overlooked cornerstone of society and our friendships.
ja: しかし、忠誠という重荷は、背負うのが容易ではないとしても、社会や友情にとってかけがえのない、そしてしばしば見過ごされがちな礎なのだ。

key: While Ghost Types may appear intimidating or mean, at the end of the day, they're just practicing their sense of humor.
en: While Ghost Types may appear intimidating or mean, at the end of the day, they're just practicing their sense of humor.
ja: ゴーストタイプは威圧的で意地悪に見えるかもしれないが、結局のところ、ただユーモアのセンスを磨いているだけだ。

key: Often a darker humor, and sometimes at the expense of others, it is seldom truly ill-meaning.
en: Often a darker humor, and sometimes at the expense of others, it is seldom truly ill-meaning.
ja: 時にダークなユーモアで、他人を犠牲にすることもあるが、本当に悪意があることはめったにない。

key: Rather, cavalcades of jokes and pranks are both the sword and shield of a Ghost Type, serving to break the ice and earn favor with others, while also protecting their true, vulnerable selves from scrutiny.
en: Rather, cavalcades of jokes and pranks are both the sword and shield of a Ghost Type, serving to break the ice and earn favor with others, while also protecting their true, vulnerable selves from scrutiny.
ja: むしろ、次々と繰り出す冗談やいたずらは、ゴーストタイプにとって剣であり盾でもあり、場を和ませ他人の好意を得る一方で、傷つきやすい本当の自分を詮索から守っている。

key: Truly getting to know a Ghost Type beneath the surface can be a challenge in its own right, but should someone be let in, there's a bright and magnetic soul to be found.
en: Truly getting to know a Ghost Type beneath the surface can be a challenge in its own right, but should someone be let in, there's a bright and magnetic soul to be found.
ja: ゴーストタイプの表面の下を本当に知ることは、それ自体が一つの試練だが、一度中に入れてもらえれば、そこには明るく人をひきつける魂が見つかる。

key: Dragon Types aren't weighed down by "common sense", rules, or expectations.
en: Dragon Types aren't weighed down by "common sense", rules, or expectations.
ja: ドラゴンタイプは、「常識」やルール、期待に縛られない。

key: As free-thinkers who read between the lines, they have a wealth of things to offer the world and those around them.
en: As free-thinkers who read between the lines, they have a wealth of things to offer the world and those around them.
ja: 行間を読む自由な思想家として、世界や周囲の人々に与えられる豊かなものを持っている。

key: They can be intense and particular, but only because they quickly come to understand in wisdom what many others cannot.
en: They can be intense and particular, but only because they quickly come to understand in wisdom what many others cannot.
ja: 激しくこだわりが強いこともあるが、それは多くの人が理解できないことを、素早く英知として理解してしまうからに過ぎない。

key: Dragon Types often struggle to make close friends, but when they do attach to people, it is never lightly, always forming an unshakable bond sure to alter each of their lives forevermore.
en: Dragon Types often struggle to make close friends, but when they do attach to people, it is never lightly, always forming an unshakable bond sure to alter each of their lives forevermore.
ja: ドラゴンタイプは親しい友達を作るのに苦労することが多いが、いざ人に心を寄せる時は決して軽々しくなく、必ずお互いの人生を永遠に変えるほどの揺るぎないきずなを築く。

key: Dark Types are the most reserved.
en: Dark Types are the most reserved.
ja: あくタイプは、最も控えめな性格だ。

key: They tend to be in conflict with both others around them and themselves, and often prefer to keep their distance as a result.
en: They tend to be in conflict with both others around them and themselves, and often prefer to keep their distance as a result.
ja: 周囲の人とも自分自身とも対立しがちで、その結果、距離を置くことを好むことが多い。

key: Nevertheless, Dark Types have many hidden strengths, varying from person to person.
en: Nevertheless, Dark Types have many hidden strengths, varying from person to person.
ja: それでも、あくタイプには人それぞれ異なる、多くの隠れた強さがある。

key: Often able to do things others aren't, or with a perspective no one else would have, they can make for invaluable allies.
en: Often able to do things others aren't, or with a perspective no one else would have, they can make for invaluable allies.
ja: 他の人にはできないことができたり、誰も持ち得ないような視点を持っていたりすることが多く、かけがえのない味方になり得る。

key: Still, it is rare that they ever let people too close to their hearts...
en: Still, it is rare that they ever let people too close to their hearts...
ja: それでも、人を心の奥深くまで入れることは、めったにない……

key: Steel Types don't let much get to them.
en: Steel Types don't let much get to them.
ja: はがねタイプは、めったなことでは動じない。

key: Steadfast, even-keel, and direct, they know what they want, how they want it, and one way or another, they'll get it.
en: Steadfast, even-keel, and direct, they know what they want, how they want it, and one way or another, they'll get it.
ja: 揺るぎなく、安定していて、率直。自分が何を、どう望むのか分かっていて、どうにかしてそれを手に入れる。

key: While they can be prone to cynicism or nihilism, they often make reliable comrades and effective colleagues.
en: While they can be prone to cynicism or nihilism, they often make reliable comrades and effective colleagues.
ja: 皮肉屋や虚無的になりがちなこともあるが、頼れる仲間や有能な同僚になることが多い。

key: Fairy Types are optimistic and inspiring!
en: Fairy Types are optimistic and inspiring!
ja: フェアリータイプは、楽観的で人を鼓舞する存在だ!

key: They often strive to be a source of light and goodness in their communities, making for fast friends and strong leaders.
en: They often strive to be a source of light and goodness in their communities, making for fast friends and strong leaders.
ja: コミュニティの中で、光と善の源であろうと努めることが多く、すぐに友達になれて、頼れるリーダーにもなる。

key: Their much-needed whimsy and creativity can often fill an emptiness where the dusts of routine and melancholy begin to settle.
en: Their much-needed whimsy and creativity can often fill an emptiness where the dusts of routine and melancholy begin to settle.
ja: その、なくてはならない気まぐれさと創造性は、日常のほこりと憂鬱が積もり始めた空虚さを、しばしば埋めてくれる。

key: But for all their goodness, Fairy Types expect the same respect from others as they offer, and if one fails to return it, the backlash can be severe...
en: But for all their goodness, Fairy Types expect the same respect from others as they offer, and if one fails to return it, the backlash can be severe...
ja: しかし、その善良さゆえに、フェアリータイプは自分が与えるのと同じ敬意を他人にも期待し、それが返されないと、反動は深刻なものになりかねない……
